description:
Austin & Wyatt are pleased to present this stylish one-bedroom apartment with balcony and parking.

A beautifully presented and contemporary one-bedroom apartment, offering a perfect blend of comfort and convenience, making it an ideal purchase for first-time buyers, investors, or professionals.

The property features a bright and spacious open-plan living area, finished to a high standard with a sleek, modern feel throughout. Large doors lead out onto a private balcony, providing the perfect space to relax or entertain.

The kitchen is stylish and well-appointed, offering ample storage and workspace, while the double bedroom is generously sized and filled with natural light. A modern bathroom completes the interior.

Further benefits include off-street parking, secure entry, and a well-maintained development.

Key Features:
• Modern one-bedroom apartment
• Private balcony
• Off-street parking
• Open-plan living space
• Well-presented throughout
• Ideal first-time buy or investment
